title: Firm-Level Litigation Risk: Measurement and Effects
eligible_reason: No difference-in-differences or binary staggered treatment. All 38 regressions in replication_oct2.do regress a future lawsuit indicator (faa_suit, fsuit_securities3, fsuit_nonsecurities3) or future corporate policies (settlements, fines, cash, capex, R&D, acquisitions scaled by assets) on the continuous text-based litigation-risk measure neg_net3_w (or alllegal_net3_w, nonneg_net3_w, chatgptboth, standardized versions, lr_current/lr_future) with firm-level time-varying controls and gvkey + circuit-by-year (or fyear, sic2-by-year, sic2 + circuit-year) fixed effects, clustered by gvkey. The 'staggered' full-text flag does not correspond to any staggered binary treatment in the code.
design_notes: Firm-year panel 2000-2022 (Compustat-CRSP merged, Audit Analytics lawsuits, 10-K text measure). Typical spec: reghdfe faa_suit neg_net3_w log_asset_w salesgrow_w xret_mean_w ret_skewness_w ret_sd_w to_mean_w aa_suit, a(gvkey circuit_yr) cluster(gvkey). Also quintile-based descriptive figures and word clouds.
data_files_note: readme.txt: WRDS-licensed Compustat/CRSP/Audit Analytics data cannot be shared; 'We provide pseudo data (for structure and code testing only)... Running the pipeline on pseudo data reproduces the workflow but not the published estimates.' Log files from the actual data (LogFiles/actual_ms_oct3.txt) are included.
priority_note: Not eligible (continuous regressor, no DiD) and pseudo data only.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). All regression commands in data/packages/mnsc.2024.05821_regressions.txt reviewed; none contains a binary post-treatment indicator. Add to data/synthetic_packages.txt if not already listed.
